one_line: Seventeenth‑century Maharaja of Tripura who lost and reclaimed his throne between the Mughals and Arakan.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but athletic build, average height with a poised royal bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp eyebrows, neatly trimmed thin moustache with a short goatee, a small tilak mark on the forehead, and a calm, thoughtful default expression that can quickly harden into resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a low knotted bun at the back of the head, partly hidden under a small Mughal-influenced Tripuri royal turban: a soft, low, wrapped turban in rich maroon with a narrow golden border and a single small white feather tucked on the left side.
appearance.costume: He wears a long knee‑length cotton jama (Anglo‑Mughal style coat) tailored to the waist and flaring slightly at the bottom, in muted cream with fine vertical maroon stripes and narrow gold piping along the edges; it fastens slightly off-center with small cloth buttons and is worn over a simple light‑cotton inner tunic. Around his waist is a broad maroon cloth patka sash with woven geometric patterns in dark gold, knotted to one side with the loose end hanging down to mid‑thigh. His lower garment is a pair of narrow churidar trousers in deep indigo, tightly gathered at the ankles for ease of movement. On his feet he wears brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes and minimal gold stitching. Jewellery is restrained but royal: a single medium‑width gold necklace with a small round pendant, a pair of plain gold stud earrings, one simple gold ring on his right hand, and a slim gold bangle on his left wrist. For travel or scenes in Arakan or the Chittagong Hill Tracts he also has a light cotton shawl in pale off‑white with a subtle red border draped over one shoulder, but his default look keeps it folded over his left forearm rather than fully wrapped.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved, single‑edged Indo‑Persian talwar sword with a plain steel blade, a brass hilt with a disc pommel, and a simple dark brown leather scabbard; the scabbard is suspended from a plain brown leather belt worn over his patka sash.

ref_desc: Govinda Manikya is a lean mid‑30s Tripuri king with medium‑brown skin, a thin moustache and short goatee, black hair in a low bun under a maroon gold‑trimmed turban, wearing a cream maroon‑striped jama, maroon patka, indigo churidar, brown mojari shoes, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a brass‑hilted talwar in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Govinda Manikya, a lean mid‑30s Tripuri king with medium‑brown skin, oval face, sharp brows, straight nose, a thin moustache with a short goatee, and a small tilak, keeping his default expression calm and thoughtful. His thick black hair is tied into a low bun at the back, partly hidden under a small royal turban: a soft low wrapped turban in rich maroon with a narrow golden border and a single small white feather tucked on the left side. Dress him in a historically accurate 17th‑century Tripura–Mughal court outfit: a knee‑length cotton jama in muted cream with fine vertical maroon stripes and narrow gold piping along the edges, fastening slightly off‑center, worn over a light inner tunic; a broad maroon patka sash with dark gold geometric patterns knotted at his waist, with the end hanging to mid‑thigh; and narrow indigo churidar trousers gathered at the ankles. Show brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, a simple gold necklace with a small round pendant, plain gold stud earrings, one gold ring on his right hand, and a slim gold bangle on his left wrist. Include a pale off‑white shawl with a subtle red border folded neatly over his left forearm, not wrapped around him. His signature weapon is a slightly curved talwar sword with a plain steel blade, brass hilt and disc pommel, in a dark brown leather scabbard hanging from a plain brown leather belt worn over the patka. Use a palette dominated by maroon, cream, indigo, gold and brown leather, and present him front‑view and three‑quarter‑view to clearly show face, hair, costume details and sword placement.
